name: Thin Totem — Slimmer Totem Pop
summary: Slims down the totem of undying so its pop animation no longer blocks your view mid-fight.
body:
Pop a totem in a fight and the vanilla animation covers a big part of your screen. This pack makes the totem **thinner**.

- 🪶 **Thin totem** — far less screen coverage when it pops
- ⚔️ **Stay in the fight** — keep track of your opponent
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
